headline: Leo needs the budget numbers before his 11:00 call, and Priya is still waiting on the launch date.

waiting.said: Morning! Can you send me the Q4 budget numbers before my call with finance at 11? Just the totals per team is fine.
waiting.gist: Wants the Q4 budget totals per team before his call with finance
waiting.reply: Hi Leo, here are the Q4 totals per team: [paste the totals]. The full sheet is in the Finance channel if they ask for detail.

waiting.said: @Maya do we have a final date for the beta launch? Marketing wants to book the newsletter slot this week.
waiting.gist: Needs the final beta launch date so marketing can book the newsletter
waiting.reply: Hi Priya, the beta goes out on [date]. Go ahead and book the newsletter slot for that week.

waiting.said: Maya, which of the two onboarding versions should we test first? I can set it up today.
waiting.gist: Asks which onboarding version to test first
waiting.reply: Hi Tom, let's test [version B] first, it has the shorter sign-up. Thanks for setting it up!

waiting.said: Are you joining the team lunch on Friday? Booking the table tomorrow.
waiting.gist: Asks if you are coming to the team lunch on Friday

promises.said: I'll send you the hiring plan by Friday.
Let me check with legal and get back to you on the contract wording.
promises.gist: Get back to Ana on the contract wording after legal

decided.gist: The beta moves out of this sprint so the team can fix sign-up first
Release freeze starts Thursday at noon
Fridays are meeting-free from next week
